ops.body:
Native acceptance evidence (Run wf_cc097b47-ec5; branch cc-sync/native-acceptance @ 7ae2d5568457 = sessionrestore d35d445 + native-fixtures 17135ee + harness).
- Scope: real installed claude 2.1.283 (haiku), a live source session, a replica built at runtime, the source cwd and every source native file deleted, the real sessionrestore Prepare/Apply, then resume through the plan's actual Launch argv. Gate `go test -tags native -count=1 -run TestNative ./internal/sessionrestore/ -v`: PASS, 38 s, about $0.50 spend. No adapter bug found; the sessionrestore package is unchanged.
- 1 Cross-cwd + source unavailable (Unicode cwd): PASS. The resumed run reports the dst cwd and dst memory path, Bash pwd shows dst, the env change is appended natively, source environment records stay byte-identical after install and resume, session_id is equal, and exactly one native copy exists.
- 2 Cross-config-root: NOT-COVERED. No alternate authenticated Claude config root exists on this machine (cc-pool accounts: []). The lane's read-only keychain probe was denied by the auto-mode classifier (Credential Exploration) and was correctly not retried or bypassed. The case runs the full relocated-artifact scenario when CC_SYNC_ACCEPT_CONFIG_DIR points at a second logged-in config dir. EXTERNAL GATE: needs a user login into a second config dir (e.g. `! CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.cc-sync-accept claude` then /login), or coverage from the real second-machine acceptance.
- 3 Relocated artifacts: PASS. A ~52 KB spilled tool result and a plan file: the resumed model Read both at their dst paths directly, never the source path, and both markers were answered.
- 4 Stripped snapshot + appended recovery context (F20): PASS through the adapter's Launch argv. The source host name, present only in the recovery context, is answered.
- 5 File-history and /rewind: PASS. Interactive edit via script(1); backups are captured, deleted and reinstalled; file-history-delta realParentDir is mapped; an interactive resume with /rewind shows the pre-edit checkpoint, and restoring it rewrites the dst file to ORIGINAL.
- 6 Partial tail + >200-unit emoji/Unicode cwd: PASS. DroppedTailBytes equals the cut, there are no invalid lines, and the hash-suffix memory path is correct.
- Side effects left on this machine: interactive runs added throwaway `projects[/private/tmp/cc-sync-accept-*/…]` entries to ~/.claude.json and one history.jsonl line per interactive session. These are shared files other sessions write concurrently, so they are not edited. All other throwaway files are removed and verified gone.
- Astra review of the branch is running.
